segments.html:
// One value, v, and three things that follow it.

App [ textColor = slategray,

    group: View [ x = center, y = center, width = 80%,
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 20 ],

        number: Text [ width = 100%, textAlign = center,
            fontSize = 70, fontWeight = bold, text = { "" + v } ],

        bar: Gauge [ width = 100%, value = { v },
            tint = { v < 50 ? cool : warm }, accessibilityLabel = "v" ],

        hint: Text [ width = 100%, textAlign = center,
            text = "click anywhere to change v" ]
        ],

    v: number = 40,
    cool: Color = dodgerblue,
    warm: Color = turquoise,

    onClick() { v = (v + 20) % 100 }
    ]
